name: bld2_fib_odd_index_iff_five_sq_sub_four
informal: Uses Mathlib2.r3_fib_iff_five_sq_pm_four_is_square and Mathlib2.bld_fib_even_index_iff_five_sq_add_four: y is Fibonacci iff one of the two Pell conditions holds, and the +4 condition characterises even indices; the two conditions hold simultaneously only for y = 1 = fib 1 = fib 2 (x'^2 - x^2 = 8), which settles the overlap, using strict monotonicity of fib from index 2.
